_about: The brands the landing page offers, in display order. Marque of a car comes from its VIN (mes.platform.marque_for_vin); this file only says how a brand is shown. has_data=false marks a brand under UX test: CUORE holds no vehicle data for it and says so. mark_kind: image = a coloured badge shown as is; mask = a one-colour mark drawn in the ink colour. landing_mark: used on the start page only. mark_local: a mark kept on this machine only (git-ignored) until its rights are written down; it wins when the file is there, else mark is used. Add a brand = one entry here plus its mark under web/static/brand/.
